paras.text: Bookshops in London, from the big independents to small specialists. They come from shared Google Maps lists, and each was checked in November 2026 against the shop's own pages and the press.
paras.textZh: 伦敦的书店，从大型独立书店到小型专门书店。名单来自几份共享的 Google 地图列表，2026年11月逐一对照了书店官网和媒体报道。

paras.text: This guide has no dates: it grows over time.
paras.textZh: 本导览没有固定日期，会不断更新。

items.text: Destination bookshops: worth a trip on their own. Specialists: one subject done well. Second-hand, comics and book arts: older books, comics and a place to make books.
items.textZh: 值得专程去的书店：本身就值得专程前往。专门书店：专注一个领域。二手书、漫画与书籍艺术：旧书、漫画，以及一个可以自己做书的地方。

items.text: Choose one in the Subject box, or type a name or a street in Find.
items.textZh: 在“题材”框里选一个，或者在“查找”里输入店名或街道。

items.text: Small shops keep short hours, especially on Sunday. Check before you go.
items.textZh: 小书店营业时间较短，周日尤其如此。出发前请先确认。

credits.points: Points: shared Google Maps lists; addresses and details from each shop's own pages and the press
credits.pointsZh: 点位：几份共享的 Google 地图列表；地址和信息来自各书店官网和媒体报道
